narrative.summary: Verified ownerless by design - source code, official docs, and an on-chain differential revert test all agree: no privileged account exists at all.
narrative.detail: ~$1.92M TVL. Ekubo’s own source (Core.sol / ICore.sol) has zero authority concepts anywhere in its 18-function interface. Ekubo’s own docs state explicitly it’s ownerless on EVM by design, contrasted against Ekubo’s Starknet Core, which is owner-upgradeable. An on-chain differential test confirms it: owner() and a deliberately fake selector both revert with identical empty data, while a real function on the same contract reverts with real, decoded error data - proving the "authority" selectors genuinely don’t exist rather than existing and reverting for some other reason.
